# How to PDF to Excel with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to extract tables from a pdf into an excel (.xlsx) file, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_pdf_to_excel`

## Prompt

```text
Extract tables from a PDF into an Excel (.xlsx) file.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input PDF file id.
- `pages` (optional): Pages to extract, default all. Default: all.
- `flavor` (optional): Extraction method. Default: stream.
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: pdf-to-excel-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
